Picking up an ammo brick refills the magazine and grants <pve 15% /> <pvp [?] /> increased damage for #e${9+#d} seconds. 

Buff timer begins on readying the weapon.

#e Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.

Picking up a <special/>Special ammo brick refills the magazine and grants 100 Reload and <pve 35% /> <pvp [15%] /> increased damage for #e${6+#d} seconds. 

Picking up a <heavy/>Heavy ammo brick grants the buff for #e${9+#d} seconds.

Buff timer begins on readying the weapon.
